context.problem_statement: Fit a 4-parameter sigmoid (Hill equation) dose-response model to estimate IC50 for a drug inhibition assay. The model is: response = bottom + (top - bottom) / (1 + (IC50 / dose)^hill_slope). Fit the model to the provided dose-response data using scipy.optimize.curve_fit. Report the estimated IC50 (in nM), Hill slope, and 95% confidence interval for IC50. Also compute R-squared of the fit.
context.expert_knowledge: IC50 is the drug concentration producing 50% inhibition. The 4-PL Hill equation is standard in pharmacology. Initial parameter guesses: top~100, bottom~0, IC50~geometric mean of doses, hill_slope~1. Use log-scale doses for fitting stability. R² > 0.99 indicates excellent fit for dose-response curves. Confidence intervals from the covariance matrix: CI = estimate ± 1.96 * sqrt(var).
